title: A 12TB Steam “teraleak” spills more than a decade of lost PC gaming history
summary: A 12TB data leak from Steam has exposed over a decade of cut game content and development history, including unreleased Portal 2 material and references to Half-Life 2: Episode 3. The leak provides rare insight into abandoned projects and cancelled sequels in PC gaming history. The incident raises concerns about data security and game preservation.
content: Cut content from Portal 2, hints of Half Life 2: Episode 3, and so much more.

zh.title: 一个12TB的Steam"数据大泄露"揭露了超过十年的失落PC游戏历史

title: Professor Murder Rides the Subway is a forgotten slice of dance punk perfection
summary: Professor Murder Rides the Subway was a dance punk EP from the mid-2000s NYC indie scene that embodied the era's emphasis on energetic, joyful rock before LCD Soundsystem and The Rapture dominated the genre. The band remains largely forgotten despite being integral to the underground dance punk movement. The article argues for the EP's overlooked place in indie music history.
content:
I recently dug out my CDs and started reripping them all. I've found a few forgotten gems in there, but few hit harder for me than the beautifully concise Professor Murder Rides the Subway EP. There was a period of time in the mid-aughts in NYC where it seemed like every indie band wanted you to let loose, dance like no one was watching, and just have some damn fun. Few embodied that as much as New York dance punk band Professor Murder.
LCD Soundsystem and The Rapture were the biggest names of the dance punk revival. But there were also bands like Rahim, Liars, Dan Deacon, and countless lesser-known acts on DFA that you could see on any giv …

zh.title: 《地铁上的谋杀教授》是被遗忘的舞蹈朋克完美之作
zh.summary: 《地铁上的谋杀教授》是一张来自2000年代中期纽约独立音乐场景的舞蹈朋克EP，体现了那个时代对充满活力、欢乐摇滚乐的重视，在LCD Soundsystem和The Rapture主导该流派之前。尽管这支乐队对地下舞蹈朋克运动至关重要，但仍然被人们大多遗忘。这篇文章主张该EP在独立音乐历史中被忽视的重要地位。

title: Enormous 12TB Steam leak includes abandoned Half-Life 2: Episode 3 assets
summary: Over 12 terabytes of Steam game data from 2003-2013 has been leaked, revealing assets from canceled titles like Half-Life 2: Episode 3, Portal 2 cuts, and early builds from major franchises including Call of Duty and Resident Evil. The massive breach exposes decades of gaming industry development history.
content:
Over 12 terabytes of data, containing builds of every game uploaded to Steam between 2003 and 2013, has been leaked. We don't know everything in the archives yet because of its massive size. But people have already dug up assets related to the canceled Half-Life 2: Episode 3, content cut from Portal 2, and a build of a game called F-Stop that's set in the Portal universe but is built around a camera mechanic.

The leak also includes titles from third-party developers. Early versions of Call of Duty and Resident Evil installments have been dug up, as have builds of Mirror's Edge, Batman: Arkham Asylum, and Dragon Age: Origins. And more is lik …
Read the full story at The Verge.

zh.title: 巨大的12TB Steam泄露包含被放弃的《半条命2:第三章》资源
zh.summary: 来自2003-2013年间的超过12TB Steam游戏数据被泄露，揭露了被取消游戏如《半条命2:第三章》、《传送门2》删减内容以及《使命召唤》和《生化危机》等主要特许经营权的早期版本中的资源。这次大规模泄露暴露了游戏行业数十年的开发历史。

title: Musk’s faster path to more gas turbines comes with pollution problem

title: The Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope launches to study dark matter and dark energy
summary: NASA's Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has successfully launched and is traveling to the L2 Lagrange point for a three-month journey beyond the Moon. With a field of view 100 times larger than Hubble's and infrared imaging 1,000 times faster, Roman will conduct unprecedented universe surveys and directly image exoplanets.
content:
NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Telescope blasts off. | Photo: NASA / John Kraus	

After funding struggles and a name change, the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope has been successfully launched. It will now make a three-month, one-million-mile journey to its orbit at the second Sun-Earth Lagrange point (L2) beyond the Moon. 
From this vantage point, Roman will conduct an unprecedented survey of the universe. Its field of view is 100 times larger than Hubble's and, according to NASA, it can survey the sky 1,000 times faster using its 300-megapixel infrared camera. Roman also has a Coronagraph system that can block and mask glare from stars, allowing it to directly image exoplanets, even smaller, older, and colder planets  …

title: Texas Governor Abbott blocks funding for more Flock cameras
summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott froze state spending on Flock AI surveillance cameras following a report showing $30 million in expenditures and growing bipartisan privacy concerns. Multiple officers have faced discipline for misusing the surveillance technology.
content:
As backlash grows over Flock's AI surveillance cameras, Texas Governor Greg Abbott has frozen state spending on them. The move came just ahead of the publication of a Texas Tribune investigation that revealed the state spent over $30 million on Flock cameras. That money was primarily raised by tacking a $1 fee onto insurance policies, allegedly to help fight catalytic converter theft.

Now Gambit's ready to really get the ball rolling with its first livestreamed event and collaborations with content creators, and Chess.com is planning to branch out into even more games from here.
